items.text: I-text ang taong may atraso ka at mag-sorry, ngayon na.

alt.en: Text someone you owe an apology to and apologize, right now.

items.text: Umiyak na parang nasa teleserye nang 15 segundo, may kasamang 'Hindi kita kailangan!'

alt.en: Perform a soap-opera crying scene for 15 seconds.

items.text: Mag-commentary na parang boxing announcer habang umiinom ng tubig si {right}, kung game siya.

alt.en: Narrate {right}'s every move like a wildlife documentary for one minute, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Mag-post ng throwback pic na may caption na 'Miss ko na 'to.'

alt.en: Post a throwback photo with the caption 'simpler times.'

items.text: Ipakita sa grupo ang pinakalumang selfie na nasa phone mo pa.

alt.en: Show the group the most embarrassing selfie still on your phone.

items.text: Hayaang ayusin ni {left} ang buhok mo kahit anong style, kung game siya.

alt.en: Let {left} restyle your hair however they like, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Gayahin si Mama o Papa kapag pinapagalitan ka.

alt.en: Do your best impression of your parent catching you sneaking in late.

items.text: Gayahin si {random} nang 15 segundo, bawal manlait, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Do a 15-second impression of {random}. Keep it friendly, and only if they're okay with it.

items.text: Ipakita sa grupo ang huling litrato sa camera roll mo.

alt.en: Show the group the last photo in your camera roll.

items.text: Mag-wacky selfie at gawing profile pic mo sa loob ng isang oras.

alt.en: Take a wacky selfie and make it your profile picture for an hour.

items.text: Ipakita kay {left} ang huli mong pinanood sa YouTube, kung game siya.

alt.en: Show {left} the last video you watched online, if they're okay with it.

items.text: I-chat ang huli mong ka-text ng 'Kumain ka na?' at wag nang magpaliwanag.

alt.en: Message the last person you texted 'Have you eaten?' and don't explain.

items.text: Kantahan si {random} ng jingle ng paborito mong fast food, kung game siya.

alt.en: Sing {random} the jingle of your favorite fast-food place, if they're okay with it.

items.text: I-rank ang barkada mula sa pinaka-maarte hanggang sa pinaka-hindi.

alt.en: Rank the group from most high-maintenance to least, out loud.

items.text: Mag-pa-cute sa grupo nang 10 segundo, kumpleto sa puppy eyes.

alt.en: Act cute for the group for 10 seconds, puppy eyes and all.

items.text: Ipakita ang huling emoji na ginamit mo at gayahin ang mukha nito.

alt.en: Show the last emoji you used and copy its face.

items.text: Iabot ang phone mo kay {random} at hayaan siyang basahin nang malakas ang pinakabagong notification mo, kung game siya.

alt.en: Hand your phone to {random} and let them read your latest notification out loud, if they're game.

items.text: Ipakita sa lahat ang screen time report mo ngayong linggo.

alt.en: Show everyone your screen time report for this week.

items.text: Makipagpalit ng accessory (cap, relo, o jacket) kay {random} hanggang sa susunod mong turn, kung game siya.

alt.en: Swap an accessory (hat, watch, jacket) with {random} until your next turn, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Mag-send ng 'May announcement ako' sa isang GC at wag magpaliwanag nang limang minuto.

alt.en: Send 'I have an announcement' to a group chat and don't explain for five minutes.

items.text: Hayaang pumili si {left} ng kanta sa playlist mo, kung game siya, tapos kantahin mo ang unang verse.

alt.en: Let {left} pick a song from your library, if they're game, then sing the first verse.

items.text: Gawing wallpaper ng phone mo ang litratong pipiliin ng grupo, buong gabi.

alt.en: Set your phone wallpaper to a photo the group picks, for the rest of the night.

items.text: Hayaang pumili ang grupo ng doodle, tapos iguhit mo sa kamay mo bilang 'tattoo' mo ngayong gabi.

alt.en: Let the group pick a doodle, then draw it on your hand as a 'tattoo' for the night.

items.text: I-rank nang malakas ang lahat dito mula sa pinakamagaling hanggang pinaka-sablay sumayaw.

alt.en: Rank everyone here from best to worst dancer, out loud.

items.text: I-chat ang crush mo noong high school ng 'Uy! Kumusta ka na?'

alt.en: Message someone you haven't talked to in over a year: 'Thought of you today, hope you're well!'

items.text: Sabihin kay {random} ang isang bagay na matagal mo nang gustong sabihin sa kanya, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Tell {random} something you've always wanted to say to them, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Bigyan si {random} ng 30-second na shoulder massage, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Give {random} a 30-second hand massage, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Haranahin si {random} ng isang linya ng love song habang nakatingin sa mata niya, kung game siya.

alt.en: Let the group pick a love song, then serenade {random} with one line, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Mag-slow dance kayo ni {random} nang isang chorus, kung game siya.

alt.en: Slow dance with {random} for one chorus while the group hums, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Bulungan si {random} ng pinaka-cheesy mong banat, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Rate your flirting skills out of 10, then prove it with one line to {random}, if they're game.

items.text: Sabihin kay {random} ang pinaka-attractive niyang ugali, nang seryoso at may eye contact, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Explain to {random}, with a straight face and eye contact, why they'd make a great partner, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Hawakan ang kamay ni {random} hanggang sa susunod mong turn, kung game siya.

alt.en: Hold hands with {random} until your next turn, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Yakapin si {random} nang 10 segundo nang hindi tumatawa, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Hug {random} for 10 seconds without laughing, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Lumuhod at mag-propose kay {random}, kumpleto sa speech, kung game siya.

alt.en: Get down on one knee and propose to {random}, full speech, if they're okay with it.

items.text: I-reenact ang huli mong break-up. Ikaw ang gaganap sa dalawang role.

alt.en: Act out your last breakup, playing both roles.

items.text: Sumulat ng maikling love letter para kay {random} at basahin nang malakas, kung game siya.

alt.en: Write a 60-second love letter to {random} and read it aloud, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Pumili ng ka-date mo ngayong round at tumabi sa kanya, kung game siya.

alt.en: Pick someone to be your date for the next round and sit next to them, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Hayaang basahin ni {random} ang huling limang chat mo nang 10 segundo, kung game siya.

alt.en: Let {random} read your last five chats for 10 seconds, if they're game.

items.text: Gumawa ng dating profile para kay {random} sa loob ng 30 segundo, puro papuri, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Make up a 30-second dating profile for {random}, nothing but compliments, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Titigan si {random} nang 20 segundo, kung game siya. Ang unang tumawa, kakanta ng chorus.

alt.en: Have a 20-second staring contest with {random}, if they're game. First to laugh sings a chorus.

items.text: I-like ang pinakalumang litrato sa profile ng ex mo.

alt.en: Like the oldest photo on your ex's profile.

items.text: Ilarawan ang dream date mo na parang trailer ng romcom, naka-slow-mo na boses pa.

alt.en: Describe your dream date like a rom-com trailer, slow-motion voice and all.

items.text: Ipakita ang huling thirst trap na sinave o ni-like mo.

alt.en: Show the last thirst trap you saved or liked.

items.text: Mag-voice message sa crush mo ng 'Ingat ka pauwi, ha' sa pinaka-malambing mong boses.

alt.en: Send your crush a voice message saying 'Get home safe, okay?' in your sweetest voice.

items.text: I-reenact kasama si {random} ang pinaka-kilig na eksena sa paborito mong teleserye, kung game siya.

alt.en: Re-enact the most swoon-worthy scene from your favorite soap opera with {random}, if they're game.

items.text: Hayaang ang grupo ang pumili ng emoji na ire-react mo sa story ng crush mo.

alt.en: Let the group pick the emoji you react with on your crush's story.

items.text: Ikuwento ang love life mo na parang DJ ng late-night love advice show sa radyo.

alt.en: Tell your love life story like a DJ on a late-night love-advice radio show.

items.text: I-describe ang ideal jowa mo gamit lang ang mga ulam.

alt.en: Describe your ideal partner using only food.

items.text: I-chat ng 'Hi, kumusta?' ang huling nag-react sa story mo.

alt.en: Message 'Hi, how are you?' to the last person who reacted to your story.

items.text: Ipakita kung paano ka lumandi kapag lasing ka na.

alt.en: Show us how you flirt when you're drunk.

items.text: Kunwari ex mo si {random} at nagkasalubong kayo sa mall. Act it out, kung game siya.

alt.en: Pretend {random} is your ex and you just bumped into each other at the mall. Act it out, if they're game.

items.text: Hayaang i-scroll ni {random} ang camera roll mo nang sampung segundo, kung game siya.

alt.en: Let {random} scroll through your camera roll for ten seconds, if they're game.

items.text: Pipili ang grupo ng contact mo. Padalhan siya ng voice message na kinakanta mo ang isang linya ng love song.

alt.en: Let the group pick a contact, then send them a voice note of you singing one line of a love song.

items.text: Basahin nang malakas ang huling mensahe sa pinakaluma mong chat na hindi mo pa nirereplyan.

alt.en: Read out the last message in your oldest unanswered chat.

items.text: Sabihin sa grupo ang tatlong bagay na totoong hinahangaan mo kay {random}, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Tell the group three things you genuinely admire about {random}, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Ipakita sa grupo ang most-used emoji mo at sabihin kung kanino mo ito madalas i-send.

alt.en: Show the group your most-used emoji and explain who you send it to most.

items.text: Hayaang mag-send si {random} ng isang wholesome na emoji sa kahit sino sa contacts mo, kung game siya.

alt.en: Let {random} send one wholesome emoji to anyone in your contacts, if they're game.

items.text: Ipakita sa grupo kung sino ang huli mong sinearch sa social media.

alt.en: Show the group the last person you searched for on Instagram.

items.text: I-describe ang dream first-kiss setting mo sa eksaktong sampung salita.

alt.en: Describe your ideal first-kiss setting in exactly ten words.

items.text: Hayaang tanungin ka ni {random} ng isang spicy na yes-or-no question, kung game siya. Bawal mag-pass.

alt.en: Let {random} ask you one spicy yes-or-no question, if they're game. No passing.

items.text: Gumawa ng malanding message para sa crush mo, ipabasa sa grupo, at sila ang boboto kung ise-send mo.

alt.en: Draft a flirty message to your crush, let the group read it, and let them vote on whether you send it.

items.text: Bigyan si {random} ng pinaka-pa-fall mong titig nang buong limang segundo, kung game siya.

alt.en: Give {random} your best smolder for five full seconds, if they're game.

items.text: Isulat ang dating-app bio ng dream jowa mo at basahin nang malakas.

alt.en: Write your dream partner's dating-app bio and read it out loud.

items.text: I-reenact ang pinaka-awkward mong first date kasama si {random} bilang ka-date mo, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Re-enact your most awkward first date with {random} as your date, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Hanapin ang pinaka-cheesy na love song sa phone mo at i-lip-sync ang chorus sa harap ng grupo.

alt.en: Find the cheesiest love song on your phone and lip-sync the chorus to the group.

items.text: Ibulong kay {random} ang pinakamalaki mong turn-on, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Whisper your biggest turn-on in {random}'s ear, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Umupo sa lap ni {random} hanggang sa susunod mong turn, kung game siya.

alt.en: Sit on {random}'s lap until your next turn, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Bigyan ng mabilis na smack si {random}, kung game kayong pareho. Kung hindi, flying kiss na lang.

alt.en: Give {random} a quick peck, only if both are game. If not, blow them a kiss.

items.text: Tanggalin ang relo, medyas, o jacket mo sa pinaka-seductive na paraan na kaya mo.

alt.en: Take off one accessory (watch, jacket, or socks) as slowly and seductively as you can.

items.text: Kumain ng isang pulutan sa pinaka-malanding paraan na kaya mo.

alt.en: Eat something from the table in the most seductive way possible.

items.text: Ipakita kung paano ka humalik gamit ang likod ng sarili mong kamay.

alt.en: Demonstrate your kissing technique on the back of your own hand.

items.text: Sabihin ang pinaka-cringe mong dirty talk na parang nagbabalita sa TV. Pilyo, hindi bastos.

alt.en: Say your best dirty-talk line in a serious news-anchor voice. Cheeky, not graphic.

items.text: I-review ang sarili mo sa kama na parang product review: ilang stars at isang comment.

alt.en: Describe what you're like in bed as a weather forecast.

items.text: Kantahin ang kantang ipe-play mo kapag may 'bisita' ka sa kuwarto.

alt.en: Hum the song you'd put on for a hookup. The group has to guess it.

items.text: Gawin ang walk of shame mo papuntang CR, bitbit ang sapatos.

alt.en: Do your best walk of shame across the room, shoes in hand.

items.text: Bigyan ng back hug si {random} nang 10 segundo, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Give {random} a 10-second back hug, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Titigan si {random} at sabihin nang seryoso, 'Sa inyo o sa amin?' kung game siya.

alt.en: Look {random} in the eye and ask 'Your place or mine?' with a straight face, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Mag-thirst trap pose nang 10 segundo habang kunwaring photographer ang grupo. Bawal ang totoong picture.

alt.en: Strike your best thirst-trap pose and hold it for 10 seconds. No photos.

items.text: Hayaang ang grupo ang pumili ng malanding palayaw mo. 'Yan ang tawag sa 'yo hanggang sa susunod mong turn.

alt.en: Let the group pick a sexy nickname for you. Everyone uses it until your next turn.

items.text: Landiin si {right} gamit lang ang food pick-up lines nang 20 segundo, kung game siya.

alt.en: Flirt with {right} using only food puns for 20 seconds, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Mag-lap dance sa bakanteng upuan nang 10 segundo.

alt.en: Give an empty chair your best 10-second lap dance.

items.text: Halikan sa pisngi si {random}, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Kiss {random} on the cheek, if they're okay with it.

items.text: Mag-body roll nang 10 segundo habang nagbi-beatbox ang grupo.

alt.en: Do a 10-second body roll while the group beatboxes.

items.text: Umikot nang tatlong beses, tapos halikan sa pisngi kung sino ang kaharap mo, kung okay lang sa kanya.

alt.en: Spin around three times, then cheek-kiss whoever you're facing, if they're okay with it.

items.text: I-recite ang alphabet sa pinaka-seductive mong bedroom voice.

alt.en: Recite the alphabet in your most seductive bedroom voice.
